title: Total cohomology of the specified Cech resolution double complex
statement: Let C be a category with v-small Hom sets and finite wide pullbacks, J a Grothendieck topology with sheafification for v-small abelian groups, F an abelian sheaf, I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], X an object of C, and pi_i : U_i → X a family indexed by a type in universe v. Assume Ext in abelian sheaves can be computed in universe v, and the sieve generated by the family is covering in J. For every n ≥ 0, the degree-n homology of the total complex of D [def-sc-cech-resolution-double-complex] is isomorphic to H^n(X,F) [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. This statement concerns a specified resolution and double complex and asserts no column-cohomology identification.

proof.text: Augment each Cech row by I^q(X) using restriction maps. Degree-zero Cech cohomology is I^q(X) by the sheaf condition, and positive degrees vanish by injective Cech acyclicity (Stacks Tags 03AW and 03F6). The Hom-set and group-value universes agree here, so the free representables in this argument are v-small. Apply SiteCechComplex.mathlib_complex_iso_exists to transport this row calculation from chosen fibre products to the Mathlib Cech complex; its product comparisons commute with the alternating differential.

Restriction commutes with the resolution differential, so these augmentations define a chain map I(X) → Tot D. Filter its cone by resolution degree. The row cohomology is zero by the augmented-row calculation. The complex is bounded below (the augmentation can occupy Cech degree -1) and each diagonal has finitely many terms. Therefore the finite filtration spectral sequence has zero abutment, the cone is acyclic, and the chain map is a quasi-isomorphism.
Computing Ext from the free abelian sheaf on X with the injective resolution I identifies H^n(I(X)) with H^n(X,F). Compose with the inverse of the augmentation homology isomorphism.

theorem Sheaf.cechResolutionDoubleComplex_total
    {F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}} (I : InjectiveResolution F) (X : C)
    {ι : Type v} {U : ι → C} (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (((Sheaf.cechResolutionDoubleComplex I X π).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n ≅ F.H' n X)
